# Task 

Find the correlation with US Karen data and the other three countries in the future 30 years. (assume only female karens)

# Imports

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("karen-helper-fns.R")

karens = read_csv("full-names-data-nice.csv")
```

# Get Only Female Karens for US and Europe

```{r}
us_karens = karens %>%
  filter(country == "United States" &
           sex == "Girl" &
           name == "Karen")

ni_karens = karens %>%
  filter(country == "ni" &
           sex == "Girl" &
           name == "Karen")

scotland_karens = karens %>%
  filter(country == "scotland" &
           sex == "Girl" &
           name == "Karen")

england_wales_karens = karens %>%
  filter(country == "England/Wales" &
           sex == "Girl" &
           name == "Karen")
```

# Visualize and Find Correlation For Each in Numbers

```{r}
us_karens = us_karens %>%
  filter(us_karens$year %in% 1974:2024)

range(us_karens$year)
```

```{r}

```

# Visualize

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = us_karens, aes(x = year, y = number, color = "United States")) +
  geom_point(data = scotland_karens, aes(x = year, y = number, color = "Scotland")) + 
  geom_point(data = england_wales_karens, aes(x = year, y = number, color = "England & Wales")) + 
  geom_point(data = ni_karens, aes(x = year, y = number, color = "Northern Ireland")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("United States" = "red", "Scotland" = "blue", "England & Wales" = "green", "Northern Ireland" = "orange")
  ) +
  labs(color = "Place of Birth", 
       y = "Number of Births",
       x = "Year", 
       title = "Number of Births by Year for Female Karens from 1974 to 2024 (n = 223)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
